Purchase option and returning the vehicle

At maturity, the lessee may exercise the purchase option by giving written notice no later than 15 calendar days before the scheduled end date and paying the stated purchase price plus applicable taxes.

Until the purchase is completed and all amounts due are paid, title remains with the lessor.

If the lessee does not exercise the option, the vehicle must be returned by the scheduled end date to a return center designated by the lessor.

Either party may request an early termination quote, but this request does not itself end the lease. Early termination becomes effective only after the vehicle is surrendered and the final amount due is paid.
